scenarios.note: Pinned page: every chart is a ChartContainer of 320x200 px (className aspect-auto h-[200px] w-[320px], initialDimension 320x200, so the measured container equals the initial one), animation off, series data fixed. Hover rule: a hover step targets .recharts-wrapper with position {x, y} relative to its top-left; x is the centre of the category band, left + (i + 0.5) * plotWidth / n, where left = margin.left (5) + the widths of the y axes and plotWidth = 320 - 5 - 5 - those widths (310 / 6 = 51.667 px per month, no y axis: x(0) = 30.83, x(2) = 134.17, x(4) = 237.5); y = 60, inside the plot. A point scale (line, area: margin {left: 12, right: 12}) puts category i at 12 + i * 296 / (n - 1). The coordinates are derived from the data, never measured.

JSON config cannot carry an icon component, so hideIcon renders the swatch exactly like legend__bottom; this keeps the no-icon path under G2, the icon path is covered by test/chadcn/chart_test.rb (item #45).
